title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B via Ollama

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's default `nemotron-3.5-bolt:latest` (74B-A9B) tag, 25GB; NVIDIA's QAD IQ2_XXS experts with NVFP4 and Q8_0 elsewhere
